Here's everything you need to get started.

```{r eval=FALSE}
library(spacelink)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
# Mock data
n_genes = 5; n_spots = 100
normalized_counts <- matrix(log1p(rpois(n_genes*n_spots,5))/log(2), n_genes, n_spots)
spatial_coords <- expand.grid(x = seq(0, 1, length.out = sqrt(n_spots)), y = seq(0, 1, length.out = sqrt(n_spots)))
cell_type_proportions <- data.frame("CellType1"=rep(c(0.3,0.7),each=n_spots/2),"CellType2"=rep(c(0.7,0.3),each=n_spots/2))
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
global_results <- spacelink(
  normalized_counts = normalized_counts,
  spatial_coords = spatial_coords
)
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
cell_type_results <- spacelink_ctSVG(
  normalized_counts = normalized_counts,
  spatial_coords = spatial_coords,
  cell_type_proportions = cell_type_proportions,
  focal_cell_type = "CellType1"
)
```
